name: How do contractors handle unexpected problems inside older buildings?

mainEntity.name: How do contractors handle unexpected problems inside older buildings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older buildings often reveal hidden framing issues, outdated systems, or undocumented repairs once work opens up the walls or ceilings. A good contractor documents the condition, explains options clearly, and adjusts the plan without losing control of cost or schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older buildings often hide structural or system issues. The contractor should document the problem, explain options, and update the plan quickly.
